name: 😷☣️ Disease Control
desc:
Located somewhere in Central Europe, stands the first Armed Disease Control facility, representing the one and only hope of humanity's defense against disease. The ADC facility is entrusted by governments around the world to cure and eradicate the most dangerous of the biological threats.

😷 Outsider - undergo crazy experiments in hopes of a cure

🧑‍⚕️ Doctor - save your patients from deadly disease

👮 Security - keep things orderly and arrest trespassers

💣 Raider - disrupt the operations of the ADC facility

🔫 Military - put an end to all hostile forces

All gamepass purchases are final. No refunds.
🚧 Game is under active development. 🚧
